description: WRITE — submits fraud feedback to MaxMind. Report the real-world outcome of a transaction (e.g. it was a chargeback or confirmed fraud) so minFraud can improve future scoring. This mutates MaxMind's model of your traffic; it is not a read. Requires a `tag` and at least one identifier (ip_address, maxmind_id, minfraud_id, or transaction_id). API: POST /minfraud/v2.0/transactions/report (returns HTTP 204).

chargeback_code.description: The chargeback reason code, if tag=chargeback.

ip_address.description: Identifier: the IP address of the reported transaction.

maxmind_id.description: Identifier: the 8-character maxmind_id from a prior response.

minfraud_id.description: Identifier: the minfraud_id (UUID) from a prior response.

tag.description: REQUIRED. The outcome you are reporting for this transaction.

transaction_id.description: Identifier: your own transaction_id sent at scoring time.

name: minfraud_report_transaction
title: Report a transaction outcome
